routes.boundary: Use Terra as the default coordinator; escalate open-ended, high-value, or unusually ambiguous work to Sol.
Use only for bounded classification, normalization, read-only analysis, and requirement shaping with a deterministic oracle.

Use for confirmed, reversible, tightly scoped implementation and ordinary test authoring. Escalate cross-module ambiguity to Terra/medium and repeated strategy failure to Sol/medium. GPT-5.4-mini may be sampled only as a non-authoritative challenger after new comparable evidence justifies it.
Do not explore in the decision path. A challenger may run read-only in shadow mode but cannot decide acceptance, authority, merge, or release.

Route approved L2/L3 backend API E2E contract and runnable-test authoring to the dedicated backend_e2e_engineer, fixed to Sol in Codex. Terra is an explicit availability fallback only. Synthetic results do not bypass main-agent checks that the exact file is collected, produces a trustworthy RED, and passes against the declared runtime.
Use Terra for ordinary correctness and maintainability review. Escalate high-risk, cross-contract, or contradictory evidence to a read-only Sol review; protected review Gates never explore.
Use one QA mode per invocation: test_design or test_review. When QA owns a protected Gate, exploit only and require main-agent evidence review.
Use for dependency, contract, current-revision evidence, and milestone readiness synthesis. Escalate material contract conflicts to Sol; never delegate merge or acceptance authority.
Exploit only. Increase to high reasoning for credible high-impact attack paths, authorization boundaries, or sensitive-data exposure; do not run destructive exploitation.
Use Terra for bounded frontend, backend, data, reliability, or UI/UX architecture. Escalate distributed, irreversible, or unusually ambiguous design to Sol.
Exploit only on L3 or qualifying L2 risk. Give one adversarial focus, keep the context narrow, and return findings without fixing or approving the design.
Use for open-ended, high-impact, adversarial, or unusually ambiguous work. Increase reasoning only after task framing and context reduction fail.
